sloka: स्व धर्मम् प्रचरिष्यन्ति दण्डकेषु महर्षयः ।एतस्मिन् अनंतरे वीरो लक्ष्मणः सह सीतया ॥३-३०-३७॥
transliteration: sva dharmam pracariṣyanti daṇḍakeṣu maharṣayaḥ ।etasmin anaṁtare vīro lakṣmaṇaḥ saha sītayā ॥3-30-37॥

translations.english: In the mean time, heroic Lakshmana accompanied by Sita came out of the mountain cave happily and entered the hermitage.
